name: 视频去水印
summary: 每 10 秒 100 点，不足 10 秒按一份计费；分段去水印后合成为一个视频。
author: Allan

commands.name: 去水印
commands.description: 输入一个视频；每段最长 8 秒，经 RunningHub 去水印后按顺序合并。

privacy.notice: 所选视频将上传到 Glance，并按最长 8 秒分段上传至 RunningHub 去水印；结果会合并并上传回 Glance。

en.name: Video Watermark Remover
en.summary: 100 credits per 10 seconds, rounded up. Clean segments and merge them into one video.

run.name: Remove Watermark
run.description: Takes one video; segments of up to 8 s are cleaned on RunningHub and merged in order.
